name: auto-tab-switcher
description: Automatically switches to the next tab every few seconds

scripts.build:compile: npm run build:ts && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:all: npm run build:compile && npm run build:settings
scripts.build:free: BUILD_PREMIUM=false BUILD_TYPE=production-free node scripts/generate-build-config.js && npm run build:all && npm run build:minify
scripts.build:premium: BUILD_PREMIUM=true BUILD_TYPE=production-premium node scripts/generate-build-config.js && npm run build:all && npm run build:minify
scripts.dev: BUILD_PREMIUM=true BUILD_TYPE=development node scripts/generate-build-config.js && npm run build:compile && npm run watch
